name: Streaming and Event Processing
summary: Data that does not wait for the nightly job: events arriving all the time, processed as they arrive — and still correct when one turns up late.
prerequisites: Requires Python. It also assumes you have built a batch pipeline: streaming is the second way to move data, and almost every decision in it is a reaction to what batch cannot do.
